hero.subtitle: VIHEPAT supports people living with HIV or viral hepatitis every day: treatment, appointments, and connection with the care team, wherever you are.

steps.title: How it works
steps.subtitle: Four simple steps to keep track of your treatment.
steps.s1_text: Simple, personalized alerts so you never miss a dose or an appointment.
steps.s2_text: The app works without connection and syncs as soon as the network returns.
steps.s3_text: Health staff monitor adherence and intervene at the right time, securely.
steps.s4_text: Neutral icon, no visible signs: your health stays your private matter.

trust.title: Trust built into every detail
trust.t1_text: Everything stays accessible offline, even in areas with poor network coverage.
trust.t2_text: Your information is end-to-end encrypted and securely stored.
trust.t3_text: Patient and caregiver spaces are separated: everyone only sees what concerns them.

caregiver.title: A clear, traceable, secure caregiver space
caregiver.subtitle: Monitor patient adherence, enter lab results, and intervene at the right time. Every access is logged.
caregiver.bullet1: Entry of viral load, CD4, transaminases

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: No, never. VIHEPAT is an assistant that supports the patient between consultations. Medical follow-up remains with health professionals.
faq.q2: Do I need a permanent internet connection?
faq.a2: No. The app works offline and syncs data as soon as the network returns. Designed for low-coverage areas.
faq.a3: Only you and your referring caregiver. Every access is logged. Data is encrypted and separated between patient and caregiver spaces.
faq.a4: Yes. Neutral icon, discreet name, silent notifications, and a personal access code: confidentiality is at the heart of the design.

cta.title: Loved ones and peer support
cta.subtitle: A caring space for caregivers and peer groups, always respecting your privacy.

footer.tagline: Continuity of care for HIV and viral hepatitis. Designed in Benin, scalable to any resource-limited setting.
